note: Adds to the pass 5 update files. The original findings.json is unchanged. Source: MAX30001 datasheet pages 57, 67 and 68 via the alldatasheet.com mirror (third-party text).

updates.status: CNFG_BIOZ D[23] BIOZ_RATE = 0 gives 64 sps at fMSTR 32,768 Hz (page 57, Table 38). The OpenView 128 sps label is wrong. The producer's every-other-frame hold matches the chip.

Streaming BioZ decoder reads ETAG from D[5:3] (data bits). It keeps only BTAG 000 and drops valid time-step samples 001, 010 and 011. Overflow (111) is never detected on this path. Page 67 Table 50 is the reference.

Page 67: BTAG 110 = FIFO empty, discard without incrementing time base. getBioZSample() and getECGSample() store every word as valid, so empty words become samples. Matches the Nordic report (0x000037 read as zero).
MAX30001 BioZ FIFO is 8 words x 24 bits (page 67). At 64 sps that is about 125 ms of buffer. Design risk for loops that stall; not measured.
